jev.note: The input rate is the documented one. Output tokens are not billed: on 2026-10-05 the TypeSafe usage page showed $0.056 for 1,640,194 tokens and 1,451 requests, which is input tokens times the rate; it would have shown about $0.069 if every token were billed (docs/validation-log.md entry 24). To be read again after the 10,000 gate.

memo.note: The memo is one call a run. Chosen on 2026-10-05 by a rule written before the comparison: the cheapest of three Claude models whose first attempt passed the memo check in both trials (experiments/2026-10-05/memo-model/). Thinking is billed as output. Its spend counts against the same cap as Jev's.
